analysis.one_line_summary: A Black Friday promotional graphic styled as a store receipt offering the WavyTalk Power Wave hair crimping iron at 37% off for $66.60.
analysis.full_description: A digital graphic designed to resemble a crumpled paper store receipt placed over a dark burgundy-purple textured backdrop. The top of the receipt features the WavyTalk logo above 'Black Friday', followed by a large headline '$66.60 | 37% OFF'. Below, receipt lines list 'POWER WAVE Wave Hair Crimping Iron' with quantity '1'. Underneath the line item sits a clean product photo of the pastel pink and rose-gold WavyTalk Power Wave crimping tool. A deep plum circular sticker on the right reads 'TODAY ONLY', and barcode slips accent the perimeter.

on_screen_text.text: ITEM QTY POWER WAVE Wave Hair Crimping Iron 1

scenes.visual: A store receipt graphic with paper texture and barcodes on a textured purple background, displaying Black Friday discount pricing and an isolated cutout of the pink WavyTalk Power Wave crimper.
